intention.context: Make MADD specifications verifiable without requiring an agent framework, and use this change as its first controlled delivery pilot.

objectives.description: A human or agent can validate a minimal contract, bind a check and inspect independent evidence without executing specification content.

out_of_scope: Qareen migration M05 awaits the relaunch retrospective.
No package publication or site deployment from a review branch.
No automatic migration of legacy agent contracts.

risks.description: An editable status could be mistaken for trustworthy delivery evidence.
risks.mitigation: Separate structural validation, binding and externally authenticated delivery evidence.
